'''Knight Gnatius''' is a character who appears in the second episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
{{section|FOTV}}

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Golden Rule]]===
He can be seen playing with a [[Plasma grenade (TV series)|plasma greande]] while a Brotherhood meeting is being held, and [[Maximus]] taking it from him. He then apologizes to Maximus.

===[[The Demon in the Snow]]===
He is sent to pick up [[Maximus]] and the [[Thaddeus|fake Harkness]] from the [[Sunset Sarsaparilla factory]].
